fact: The Kenya Health Sector Strategic Plan for July 2023 to June 2027 gives a 2022/23 baseline, sourced to KHIS, of 95% of health facilities submitting complete monthly reports and 92% submitting them on time, sets a target of 100% for each year to 2027/28, and costs its Health Information Systems area at KSh 95,286 million over the five years.
title: Kenya Health Sector Strategic Plan (KHSSP) July 2023 - June 2027: Transforming Health Systems to Achieve Universal Health Coverage
